message.reasoning_content:
Review p1-p4 visually.

p1: title cover clean, readable. "汇报日期 待补充" fine. Good.

p2: three cards have large empty white space below text — cards are tall with sparse content. Could be an improvement (density imbalance). Text readable. Hierarchy fine. Issue: cards are ~390px tall with content only at top; visually hollow. Mark improvement.

p3: tech route 5 boxes fine; metric boxes with big numbers; bottom "围绕连接方式与多工况响应展开对比" band. Looks OK. Slight: the metric row boxes appear misaligned? 18, 6, 24 boxes look same height. Fine.

p4: subtitle text wraps to second line "施。" — orphan single character on next line, slightly awkward. That's a minor typography issue. Also right stat circle "8 个月" overlaps? No. The 8 circle overlaps nothing. Subtitle wrap orphan "施。" is an improvement.

Also p4: cards 01/02/03 heights fine. Whitespace between the three cards and bottom section ok.

I'll record visual with two improvements: p2 card vertical void; p4 subtitle orphan wrap.

Should I revise? Improvements are non-blocking. Budget 600s. I could revise p2 and p4 for polish. Reasonable to fix both with revise_page. But note revise_page per page max twice. Let's first record assessment, then inspect p5-p6, then decide revisions.

Actually record visual for p1-p4 now.
